name: antislop-hermes-pi-writing-pilot-v1

tasks.question: Write a 45–80 word notice: the Oak Street library closes at 4 pm this Friday for electrical work. It reopens Saturday at 10 am. Online renewals remain available. Do not invent contact details.

Write a 50–90 word customer reply: order K17 arrived with a cracked mug. A replacement was dispatched today, delivery takes 3–5 business days, and no return is required. Be helpful without promotional language.

Write a 45–80 word visitor notice: the east entrance of the Riverside museum is closed Thursday for repairs. Use the north entrance. Opening hours and ticket prices are unchanged. Do not invent accessibility details.

Summarize in 50–80 words: 80 of 200 invited residents answered a park survey; 56 respondents wanted more benches. State the share among respondents and explain why it need not represent all residents.

reward: valid file verifier * Opus quality/4 * (0.7 + 0.3 * not_slop)
scope: one bounded GRPO update from exact native vLLM agent tokens; pilot only
